stem:
Farid looks through three sheets: clear cellophane, frosted glass, and cardboard.

Through clear cellophane he sees objects clearly. Through frosted glass he sees objects, but not clearly. Through cardboard he cannot see objects at all.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: Clear cellophane is translucent; frosted glass is transparent; cardboard is opaque.
Clear cellophane is opaque; frosted glass is translucent; cardboard is transparent.
Clear cellophane is transparent; frosted glass is translucent; cardboard is opaque.
Clear cellophane is transparent; frosted glass is opaque; cardboard is translucent.

teacher.key_rationale: Clear seeing means transparent; hazy seeing means translucent; no seeing means opaque. The other options swap those visibility labels.
